RelayServer.title: RelayServer
RelayServer.description: User-owned VPN relay endpoint configuration synchronized across devices.

name.description: Display name of the relay server (1-100 chars).

host.description: IPv4, IPv6, or domain hostname of the relay endpoint (1-253 chars).

port.description: TCP/UDP port of the relay endpoint (1-65535).

transport.description: Transport protocol label (e.g. WebSocket, TLS, SSH, HTTP Proxy, WireGuard).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the relay server record was created or saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the relay server record was last updated.

/users/{userId}/relay_servers/{serverId}.description: Private user-scoped collection of VPN relay servers.
